business_summary: Holding company whose main asset is ~80% of Axis Max Life Insurance (Axis Bank holds ~19.99% after IRDAI-approved purchase, model/search). Axis Max Life sells savings, protection and ULIPs mostly via Axis Bank (62-63% of counter) and Yes Bank/other partners (+21% growth). Q2 FY27 VNB Rs730cr (+15%), margin 27.0% (+154bp), H1 VNB +21%; consolidated PAT Rs100cr in Q2 (Rs219cr H1, +137%). Stock Rs1,284 (-25% in 6m); P/B ~7.7. IRDAI's commission/EoM draft hit it hardest of the listed lifers (-9.5% on 2026-09-24).

revenue_mix.segment: Axis Max Life: individual savings and ULIP

exposures.mechanism: IRDAI draft (2026-09-23/24) caps product commissions and lowers EoM limits; private insurers 'face a wider gap' than LIC/SBI Life (Moneycontrol 2026-09-25). MFSL fell 9.5-10% on 2026-09-24 (Kalkine/NDTV Profit). Mechanism: Axis Max Life pays high bancassurance commissions (Axis Bank ~62% of counter) -> forced EoM/commission cuts => VNB at risk -8 to -12% before cost offsets; stock trades at ~7.7x book so value moves ~1:1 with VNB => -9 central; range to +2 if IRDAI dilutes (Systematix/ET Oct 15 'not intended to disrupt business models'). Jefferies still sees 41% upside.

evidence.note: IRDAI exposure draft (2026-09-23/24): product-wise commission caps and 5-year expense limits from FY28; comments to 2026-10-25; PB Fintech -36% in a day, insurers -7 to -26% (ET/NDTV Profit/Reuters)

exposures.mechanism: +25bp: guaranteed non-par pricing improves (VNB margin +20bp ~ +0.7% VNB) vs MTM on shareholder debt and discount-rate effect on a 7.7x P/B stock; net ~0.3, low confidence.
+25bp repo -> FD rates +20-30bp competing with savings products (~55% of APE) => volume -2% x margin leverage => -0.6.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Hindu/Reuters/CNBC TV18 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +10% SIP/DII flows -> market support for ULIPs (~20-25% of APE) and fee AUM => +1.0.
+$5bn/qtr FPI inflow: pack market beta not shown; for a high-multiple financial, beta ~1.0-1.2 => +3.
+1 structural shift of savings to financial products: APE growth +2pp pa => VNB +3% x persistence 1.0 => +3.
+1pp GDP -> APE +1.5pp, lower lapses => VNB +2.5% x 0.8 => +2.
+5 VIX points -> de-rating of high-P/B insurers; ULIP sales slip.
Pack elasticity -1.26 per SSU (t -2.4) is significant but the mechanism is indirect (oil -> CPI -> yields/market risk); shrunk by ~35% toward zero => -0.8.
Pack +1.58 (t +2.0): gold as alternative savings would be negative mechanically, positive correlation likely reflects risk-on/liquidity regime; shrunk to +0.6, mechanism unclear.
+1pp CPI: real income squeeze and higher rates => -0.6.

company_links.mechanism: w = % change in MFSL equity per +1% in AXISBANK equity. Axis Bank is ~62-63% of Axis Max Life's counter (down from ~65%) and holds 19.99%: bank sentiment/incentive changes feed distribution; also a common regulatory shock (IRDAI cap hits bank fee income).
